# Valore

> Valore is the fractional brand partner that takes established, owner-led businesses from standard to premium. Founded by Derek Burbidge. Website: https://valore.agency

Valore is not a marketing agency. It is the strategic and accountability layer between a business owner and every surface of their brand. Valore sets the positioning, builds the foundation itself (the website, starter content, on-page SEO, and core automations, delivered in the Sprint), and then, for the ongoing climb, assesses the best avenue based on the marketing budget and brings in the right specialists, whom it sources, directs, and holds accountable to one direction.

## The Method: Streamline, Elevate, Flow

Valore works in three moves:
- Streamline: channel the scattered pieces of a brand into one clean current. One message, one level, everywhere the market meets it: the site, the socials, the profiles, the packaging.
- Elevate: consistency is what makes the market read a business as premium. Premium brands do not compete on price. They get chosen for what they are worth.
- Flow: streamlined and premium, the business draws a steady flow of better clients. Valore keeps that current moving and keeps it on course.

## The Brand Ladder

Every Valore engagement is framed as a climb through three stages:
- Standard: good work, competing on price, growing on referrals, invisible to the clients who would happily pay more.
- Premium: chosen for what they are worth rather than what they cost, attracting clients who trust the business on sight, earning stronger margins that hold their value when the market tightens.
- THE BRAND: the name the market thinks of first, references as the standard, and aspires to work with.

Premium is the goal Valore commits to getting a client to. THE BRAND is the further climb the retainer keeps them on. Every recommendation is built to move the client up this ladder.

## What Valore Does

- Clarifies positioning, messaging, and the ideal client
- Builds the Brand Brain, a single source of truth for who the business is, its voice, its content rules, and where it is going
- Builds a prioritized brand roadmap across six dimensions: Identity, Voice, Experience, Visibility, Conversion, and Systems
- Builds the foundation directly: a clean, premium website, a content plan and starter content, on-page SEO and keyword optimization, and the core business automations that capture and follow up on demand
- For the ongoing climb, sources, hires, and directs the right specialists (month-to-month content, backlinks and off-page SEO, ad management, deeper production), keeping all of it accountable to one brand direction
- Holds vendors accountable and aligns all marketing activity to one brand direction
- Acts as a fractional brand executive (also called a fractional brand manager or fractional CMO): builds the foundation, then directs the specialists rather than running the day-to-day production in-house

## What Valore Does Not Do

- Does not act as a long-term, in-house production team. Valore builds the foundation, but ongoing content, link building, ad management, and heavy production are delivered by specialists Valore hires and directs
- Does not run paid ad campaigns as a primary service
- Does not offer one-size-fits-all packages
- Does not work with businesses that want execution without strategy

## The Path: Brand Brain, Sprint, Retainer

### The Brand Brain (the complimentary way in)
A single source of truth that captures who a business is and who it is not, its voice, its content rules and guidelines, the templates it builds from, and where it is going. Once it exists, every tool, teammate, and vendor works from the same page, in the owner's voice, at the owner's level. Valore hands the owner the tools, the prompts, and the guiding rails, and the owner builds it privately on their own computer in about a day. It stays theirs, whether or not they go on to work with Valore. Valore never sees it. It is the entry point, and it is complimentary.

### The Sprint (the first step): https://valore.agency/sprint/
Every engagement begins here, one focused week. Valore resets the brand to premium: positioning, identity, and the plan to run it, handed over clean. Where it makes sense, the Sprint also stands up the foundation itself: a clean premium website, starter content, on-page SEO, and the core automations, so the brand launches ready. Pricing is based on the client's marketing budget, because the right scope depends on where they are and how far they want to climb.

### The Retainer (the partnership)
Valore stays on as the client's fractional brand partner: direction, accountability, vendor management, and a roadmap that keeps moving. This is where the ongoing climb lives: month-to-month content, backlinks and off-page SEO, and campaign work, delivered by specialists Valore sources, hires, and directs. Pricing is based on the client's marketing budget. Valore builds the foundation and directs the specialists rather than running heavy production in-house.

Valore costs a fraction of a full-time marketing manager (typically $80,000 or more in salary alone, well over $100,000 once benefits and overhead are loaded), directs the strategy, and frees the rest of the budget to hire real specialists per job.

## Primary Audience

Established, owner-led businesses generating high six figures to seven figures annually, built on reputation and referrals, ready to match their market presence to the quality of what they deliver. Examples: luxury renovation and custom home builders, high-end interior designers, premium landscape and outdoor-living companies, boutique wellness and aesthetics brands, high-ticket coaches and consultants, specialty trades, premium menswear and product brands, and premium professional-service firms. Geography is not a factor; the right client can operate locally, regionally, nationally, or remotely.

## Founder

Derek Burbidge founded Cardero Clothing in 2015 and spent a decade building it into a recognized premium custom menswear brand across the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland of British Columbia, Canada. He has worked alongside high-end service brands, seven and eight-figure businesses, and owner-led companies at every stage of growth. Everything Valore recommends is tested on its own brand first, so clients get the playbook, not the experiment.

## Proof

- Our own menswear brand, the lab: four times the search visibility year over year, revenue doubled over the same window, and a six hundred dollar higher average order at premium prices with no discounting.
- A B2B virtual services brand Valore led: from six to seven figures in annual revenue, revenue doubling three years running, and the number one premium name in its category.
- A premium shuttle service, at launch: rebuilt from a basic template site into a high-performing website with a content machine that captures existing demand, positioned as the premium name in its space from day one.

## Core Philosophy

Most businesses rely too heavily on one or two marketing channels. When that channel slows, the business stalls. Strong brands are built through multiple coordinated touchpoints, and through the surfaces most businesses neglect: a consistent visual identity, a clear voice, and a client experience that reflects the quality of the work. Each channel is another leg of the stool. The more legs, the more stable the brand.

## How to Work With Valore

Start the conversation with a 30-minute call, booked on the site: https://valore.agency/start/

Derek reviews the business, website, reviews, and competitive landscape before every call. The session identifies the gap between where the brand is and where it needs to be. The session ends with a clear read on where the brand stands and how Valore would help. The client leaves with at least one clear direction, whether or not they go on to work with Valore.
